sum_insured_options: Not specified in wording (refer Policy Schedule/Product Benefit Table)

room_rent.note: Room rent limits are referenced to the Policy Schedule/Product Benefit Table, not stated in the wording. Proportionate deduction applies if a higher room category is chosen.

icu.note: ICU charges covered; limits referenced to Policy Schedule/Product Benefit Table. Proportionate deductions not applicable for ICU.

copayment.note: No mandatory co-payment mentioned in the wording.

sub_limits.note: Maternity expenses (including newborn, vaccination, stem cell) capped at ₹40,000 per event (normal delivery) or ₹60,000 per event (C-section), max 2 events lifetime. Organ donor expenses and ambulance also subject to limits in Policy Schedule. Most other benefits up to Sum Insured.

initial_waiting.note: Standard 30-day waiting period for illnesses; not applicable for accidents.

ped_waiting.note: PED waiting period as per Policy Schedule/Product Benefit Table; standard is 36 months per definition.

specific_disease_waiting.note: Extensive list of specific diseases/procedures (cataract, hernia, joint replacement, skin diseases, etc.) excluded for 24 months of continuous coverage.

maternity.note: Inbuilt cover. ₹40,000/event (normal delivery) or ₹60,000/event (C-section), max 2 events lifetime. Includes newborn expenses, vaccination, stem cell preservation within maternity SI. Optional add-on available to reduce waiting period to 24 months.

cumulative_bonus.note: No Claim Bonus at 10% of SI per claim-free year, up to 100% of SI. Optional Super NCB add-on available for additional bonus up to 100% of SI. In event of claim, accumulated NCB reduced by the percentage accumulated in previous year.

restoration.note: Binge Refill: SI refilled unlimited times in a policy year once SI + NCB + Super NCB exhausted. Applies to same or different illness. Max per single claim = SI. Not carried forward to next year. Not available for maternity claims.

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation expenses covered; number of days referenced to Policy Schedule/Product Benefit Table.

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation expenses covered; number of days referenced to Policy Schedule/Product Benefit Table.

day_care.note: Day care treatment covered up to Sum Insured. Modern treatments also covered under day care.

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation covered (min 3 consecutive days). Home Treatment also covered on cashless basis via empanelled providers in selected cities.

ayush.note: AYUSH in-patient hospitalisation covered up to Sum Insured at AYUSH Hospital/Day Care Centre. OPD and treatment outside India excluded.

organ_donor.note: Organ donor harvesting expenses covered up to limits in Policy Schedule. Screening, pre/post-hosp of donor, complications from harvesting excluded.

ambulance.note: Road ambulance covered for emergency transport; limit referenced to Policy Schedule/Product Benefit Table. Domestic emergency air ambulance also available under Section C.II.(n).

modern_treatments.note: 12 listed modern treatments covered including robotic surgery, stereotactic radio surgery, oral chemotherapy, stem cell therapy (haematopoietic), HIFU, deep brain stimulation, etc.

consumables.note: Non-Medical Expense Waiver is an optional cover (Section C.IV.w) covering non-medical items listed in Annexure I that are necessarily incurred during hospitalisation, up to policy SI.

global_cover.note: Geographical exclusion: all benefits available in India only. Treatment outside India explicitly excluded.

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months of coverage (including portability/migration), no claim can be contested except on grounds of fraud.

grace_period.note: 30 days for quarterly, half-yearly and annual premium modes; 15 days for monthly premium mode.

free_look.note: Applicable on new individual policies only; not on renewals or portability/migration.

portability.note: Portability to other insurers allowed as per IRDAI guidelines with continuity of waiting period credits.

notable_exclusions: Treatment outside India, RFQMR/ECP/EECP/Hyperbaric O2/KTP laser/Cyber knife/Femto laser/bioabsorbable implants, external congenital anomalies, stem cell therapy (except haematopoietic BMT), hormone replacement therapy
optional_riders: Super NCB, Travel Protect (baggage/trip cancel/delay), Premium Waiver (CI/PTD), EMI Protection, Non-Medical Expense Waiver, Reduction in Maternity Waiting Period (36→24mo), OPD Expenses
insurer: Aditya Birla Health Insurance Co. Limited
